% chart_bert: BERT-Base bottleneck analysis of VIGOR-DFA (TIFS paper, label fig:bert).
% Analog of DFA figure_05 (Office look). Single column, final width 3.45 in.
% (a) speedup over dealer-based malicious FSS vs. network bandwidth (../data/net_sweep.csv)
% (b) LAN latency vs. host-module link bandwidth              (../data/link_sweep.csv)
% (c) LAN latency components of VIGOR-DFA                      (../data/bert_pie.csv)
% Values are the measured numbers of Section VIII, regenerated by the App. F cost
% model (model/perf_model.py) as a cross-check.
% Build: sh build_chart.sh chart_bert   (from this folder)
\documentclass[tikz,border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage[scaled=0.92]{helvet}
\renewcommand{\familydefault}{\sfdefault}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\usepackage{pgfplotstable}
\usetikzlibrary{calc}

% Office palette (DFA figure_05)
\definecolor{cOrange}{HTML}{ED7D31}
\definecolor{cBlue}{HTML}{5B9BD5}
\definecolor{cGrey}{HTML}{A5A5A5}
\definecolor{cGold}{HTML}{FFC000}
\definecolor{cDBlue}{HTML}{4472C4}
\definecolor{cGreen}{HTML}{70AD47}
\definecolor{cDOrange}{HTML}{9E480E}
\definecolor{cGrid}{HTML}{D9D9D9}
\definecolor{cAxis}{HTML}{A6A6A6}
\definecolor{cText}{HTML}{262626}
\colorlet{estRed}{red}   % red accent used for the paper's call-outs

\newcommand{\lgf}{\fontsize{7.2}{8.2}\selectfont}   % legends, data labels (>= 6.6 pt glyphs)
\newcommand{\tkf}{\footnotesize}                     % ticks, axis labels, panel tags
\newcommand{\sq}[1]{\tikz[baseline=-0.1ex]\fill[#1] (0,0) rectangle (5.2pt,5.2pt);}

\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{../data/net_sweep.csv}\netT
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{../data/link_sweep.csv}\linkT
\pgfplotstableread[col sep=comma]{../data/bert_pie.csv}\pieT

% extra latency of each link setting over the on-die (last row, 290 GB/s) setting
\pgfplotstablegetrowsof{\linkT}\pgfmathtruncatemacro{\linkLast}{\pgfplotsretval-1}
\pgfplotstablegetelem{\linkLast}{lan}\of{\linkT}\edef\onDie{\pgfplotsretval}
\pgfplotstablecreatecol[create col/expr={\thisrow{lan}-\onDie}]{extra}{\linkT}
\pgfplotstablecreatecol[create col/expr={\onDie}]{base}{\linkT}

\pgfplotsset{
  office/.style={
    scale only axis,
    axis x line*=bottom, axis y line*=left,
    y axis line style={draw=none},
    x axis line style={draw=cAxis, line width=0.6pt},
    ymajorgrids, grid style={draw=cGrid, line width=0.45pt},
    major tick length=0pt, tick style={draw=none},
    tick label style={font=\tkf, text=cText},
    label style={font=\tkf, text=cText},
    xtick=data, enlarge x limits=0.24, clip=false,
    ymin=0,
    yticklabel={\pgfmathprintnumber[assume math mode=true]{\tick}},
    xlabel style={yshift=2pt}, ylabel style={yshift=-3pt},
  },
}

\tikzset{inbar/.style={rotate=90, anchor=west, font=\lgf, text=white, inner sep=0pt}}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\tkf, text=cText]

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- (a)
\begin{axis}[office, name=A, at={(0,0)}, width=1.40cm, height=2.15cm,
    ybar stacked, bar width=0.34cm, ymax=60, ytick={0,20,...,60}, enlarge x limits=0.28,
    xlabel={Network BW (GB/s)}, ylabel={Speedup (\texttimes)},
    xticklabel={\pgfplotstablegetelem{\ticknum}{bw}\of{\netT}%
                \pgfmathprintnumber[assume math mode=true]{\pgfplotsretval}},
  ]
  \addplot[fill=cBlue, draw=none]   table[x expr=\coordindex, y=speedup_other]   {\netT};
  \addplot[fill=cOrange, draw=none] table[x expr=\coordindex, y=speedup_offline] {\netT};
  \pgfplotsinvokeforeach{0,1,2}{%
    \pgfplotstablegetelem{#1}{speedup}\of{\netT}\edef\val{\pgfplotsretval}%
    \edef\tmp{\noexpand\node[font=\noexpand\lgf, text=cText, anchor=south, inner sep=1.2pt]
      at (axis cs:#1,\val) {\noexpand\pgfmathprintnumber[fixed, precision=1,
        assume math mode=true]{\val}};}\tmp}
\end{axis}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- (b)
\begin{axis}[office, name=B, at={(2.25cm,0)}, width=2.15cm, height=2.15cm,
    ybar stacked, bar width=0.32cm, ymax=5, ytick={0,1,...,5}, enlarge x limits=0.10,
    xlabel={Module link (GB/s)}, ylabel={LAN latency (s)},
    xticklabel={\pgfplotstablegetelem{\ticknum}{link_gbps}\of{\linkT}%
                \pgfmathprintnumber[assume math mode=true]{\pgfplotsretval}},
  ]
  \addplot[fill=cBlue, draw=none]   table[x expr=\coordindex, y=base]  {\linkT};
  \addplot[fill=cOrange, draw=none] table[x expr=\coordindex, y=extra] {\linkT};
  \pgfplotsinvokeforeach{0,1,2,3}{%
    \pgfplotstablegetelem{#1}{lan}\of{\linkT}\edef\val{\pgfplotsretval}%
    \edef\tmp{\noexpand\node[font=\noexpand\lgf, text=cText, anchor=south, inner sep=1.2pt]
      at (axis cs:#1,\val) {\noexpand\pgfmathprintnumber[fixed, precision=2, zerofill,
        assume math mode=true]{\val}};}\tmp}
  \coordinate (lk0) at (axis cs:0,0.18);
  \coordinate (lk2) at (axis cs:2,0.18);
  \coordinate (lk3) at (axis cs:3,0.18);
\end{axis}
% link type written inside the bars (drawn after the axis so that it lies on top of the bars)
\node[inbar] at (lk0) {ZCU102 link};
\node[inbar] at (lk2) {PCIe-class};
\node[inbar] at (lk3) {on die};

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- legends (a), (b)
\begin{scope}[font=\lgf]
  \node[anchor=south west, align=left, inner sep=0pt] at ($(A.north west)+(-0.75cm,0.12cm)$) {%
    \sq{cOrange}\ Eliminated offline\\[-0.5pt]
    \phantom{\sq{cOrange}}\ distribution\\[-0.5pt]
    \sq{cBlue}\ Others};
  \node[anchor=south west, align=left, inner sep=0pt] at ($(B.north west)+(-0.62cm,0.12cm)$) {%
    \sq{cOrange}\ Added by off-die link\\[-0.5pt]
    \sq{cBlue}\ On-die latency};
\end{scope}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- (c) pie
\def\R{0.98cm}
\def\LW{1.535cm}% half width of the pie legend
\coordinate (L) at (6.225cm,2.18cm);% centre of the pie legend column
\coordinate (P) at (5.92cm,2.12cm); % pie centre (shifted left to free the corner tag)
\def\pieNames{{"Auth. GEMM","Online network","Other GPU work","Nonlinear gates","CPU-GPU transfer","Triples, checks, NoC"}}
% component colors match chart_motiv (GEMM light blue, network dark blue, nonlinear green,
% CPU-GPU I/O gold, other GPU grey); module-side work gets a dark orange
\def\pieCols{{"cBlue","cDBlue","cGrey","cGreen","cGold","cDOrange"}}
\pgfplotstablegetrowsof{\pieT}\pgfmathtruncatemacro{\pieN}{\pgfplotsretval-1}
% total
\def\pieTot{0}
\foreach \i in {0,...,\pieN}{%
  \pgfplotstablegetelem{\i}{seconds}\of{\pieT}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\t}{\pieTot+\pgfplotsretval}\global\let\pieTot\t}
% slices, clockwise from 12 o'clock (Office default)
\def\pieA{90}
\foreach \i in {0,...,\pieN}{%
  \pgfplotstablegetelem{\i}{seconds}\of{\pieT}\edef\v{\pgfplotsretval}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\B}{\pieA-360*\v/\pieTot}%
  \pgfmathparse{\pieCols[\i]}\edef\c{\pgfmathresult}%
  \fill[\c] (P) -- ($(P)+(\pieA:\R)$) arc[start angle=\pieA, end angle=\B, radius=\R] -- cycle;
  \draw[white, line width=0.5pt] (P) -- ($(P)+(\pieA:\R)$);
  \global\let\pieA\B}
% pie legend with red shares
\foreach \i in {0,...,\pieN}{%
  \pgfplotstablegetelem{\i}{seconds}\of{\pieT}\edef\v{\pgfplotsretval}%
  \pgfmathsetmacro{\pct}{100*\v/\pieTot}%
  \pgfmathparse{\pieCols[\i]}\edef\c{\pgfmathresult}%
  \pgfmathparse{\pieNames[\i]}\edef\nm{\pgfmathresult}%
  \node[font=\lgf, anchor=west, inner sep=0pt] at ($(L)+(-\LW,-1.30cm-\i*0.285cm)$) {\sq{\c}\ \nm};
  \node[font=\lgf, anchor=east, inner sep=0pt, text=cText] at ($(L)+(\LW,-1.30cm-\i*0.285cm)$)
    {\pgfmathprintnumber[fixed, precision=1, zerofill, assume math mode=true]{\pct}\%};
}

% ---------------------------------------------------------------- panel tags
\node[anchor=base] at ($(A.south)+(0,-1.03cm)$) {(a)};
\node[anchor=base] at ($(B.south)+(0,-1.03cm)$) {(b)};
\node[anchor=base] at ($(L)+(0,-1.03cm-2.18cm)$) {(c)};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
